title: 库奇·小飞机保养日
description: 白胡子飞行员库奇戴护目镜，在停好的小飞机旁擦拭机翼，所有机载装备保持静止。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Corki is a tiny adult yordle pilot with a large white moustache, aviator cap, oversized goggles, a warm flight jacket, gloves, and little boots. Preserve his compact quirky aircraft with rounded wings, a visible propeller, and brass mechanical fittings. The craft is firmly parked with the propeller still, and any mounted equipment remains inactive and pointed harmlessly away.
art_direction.scene: He stands on a low stable stool beside his parked little aircraft and polishes a round wing panel with a soft cloth. A small toolbox with only simple clean shapes sits below. Keep the plane and pilot fully visible, the background a quiet hangar doorway, and the whole scene focused on patient maintenance rather than flight or action.
art_direction.palette: butter yellow, leather brown, sky blue, brass
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
